name: Ergasterion lessons
say: This week we wrote down 18 lessons. The strongest (3 files agree): No edge found. None of them beat the noise bar on the training data, so none was carried forward. What changed our mind: Uncorrelated, but it does not hold in 2021-25 and passes evals too slowly.

week.text: No edge found. None of them beat the noise bar on the training data, so none was carried forward.

In 2021-25 they halve the failed Builder evals (55% - 28% within 60 sessions) and cut fees ($212 - $166 per 6 months), but the payouts fall by the same amount: the Builder still makes -$7 instead of -$9 a m…
No single fact has a bin that loses in both halves; 425 two-fact loser cells picked on Jan-Jun keep losing in Jul-Oct 88 times against 95 expected by chance.

The four that look best on paper (pre-FOMC, RSI(2), 12-month trend, overnight drift) all hold positions overnight, which MFFU does not allow (flat by 16:10 ET), and every one of them lost money in 2026 H2 or in 2021-25.

changed.text: Uncorrelated, but it does not hold in 2021-25 and passes evals too slowly.
One pocket looked real (and replicated across two assets) until I ran it on two months of data it had never seen: it vanished.

The earlier finding "95c and above is +1.4% per $" came from the bot's own bets (no market-wide data). On the market-wide data it is +0.1% (train) and -0.6% (test): that pocket is not an edge, it is the bot's entry timing plus luck.
The H2 gain of the pick (fail in 2 weeks 17.4% vs 21.7%) rests on 31 trades and does not hold in 2021-25.
If shuffled outcomes do as well, the previous result carries no information.

note: Every lesson is a sentence lifted from a file in the repo; strength = how many independent files agree. Research notes, never a trade signal.
